title: Adaptive token bridge for legacy forms and dataviz
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Problem: We have multiple legacy token namespaces in the component library (legacy-color.*, legacy-radius.*, legacy-elevation.*) used by older apps and a set of new adaptive tokens that respond to density and contrast contexts. Directly replacing tokens breaks sensitive form and dataviz surfaces: form controls lose touch-target density and dashed table borders shift contrast; charts get washed-out overlays at high-density modes.

Goal: Create an interim "adaptive token bridge" — a deterministic mapping and runtime shim that maps legacy token names to the new adaptive token set with context-aware overrides for forms and charts. The bridge should enable a low-risk migration path for product teams, provide a test harness for visual regressions, and include a migration guide + codemods for gradual rollout.

Scope:
- Map legacy token names to adaptive tokens with rule-based exceptions for form-controls, buttons, tables, and chart overlays.
- Implement SCSS/JS shim (token adapter) that can be toggled per-route via a feature flag.
- Provide variant rules for three density buckets (compact, default, comfortable) and two contrast anchors (standard, high-contrast).
- Produce visual diff suites (Chromatic + internal regression harness) for representative pages (forms, datagrid, analytics cards).

Non-Goals: Full token rename across the codebase this cycle; changing component markup or behavior beyond token mapping; introducing new tokens outside the adaptive token spec.

Constraints: Must not degrade accessibility (contrast, hit targets), cannot require breaking changes from consumers, and must be reversible (flag off) without layout shifts.
acceptance_criteria: Token adapter implements mapping table for all legacy-* tokens referenced in ui repo
Feature flag toggles adapter on/off at runtime without requiring a build
Visual regression baseline: zero >2% pixel regressions across the representative suites when adapter is enabled compared to design-approved snapshots
Accessibility checks (axe + manual) pass for form pages in all three density buckets
Migration docs and codemod shipped to repo: docs/design/token-bridge.md and scripts/codemods/legacy-to-adaptive.js
decisions: Use rule-based mapping rather than a one-to-one static rename to preserve density-specific overrides (decided 2026-02-25)
Expose mapping as a small runtime shim (JS + CSS tokens) behind a feature flag to enable per-route testing (decided 2026-02-27)
Default mapping will prefer high-contrast adaptive tokens for any legacy token with WCAG risk > AA on baseline pages (decision recorded 2026-03-01)
